name: Muskrat
desc: Muskrat (Ondatra zibethicus): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 1 times near the park in GBIF.
about: The muskrat or common muskrat is a medium-sized semiaquatic rodent. Adult muskrats weigh 0.6–2 kg (1+1⁄4–4+1⁄2 lb), with a body length (excluding the tail) of 20–35 cm (8–14 in).
